title: Greek Vegetable Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious Greek-inspired pilaf made with vegetables and a hint of yellow rice.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until tender.
Add the pilaf seasoning and yellow rice to the saucepan.
Pour in the spring water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and let simmer for 20 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
If using feta cheese, crumble it over the pilaf for extra flavor.
